description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange Effective from 16.11.2020 to 22.11.2020
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory framework for customs operations, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, or specialized administrative matter. The content involves statutory instruments and compliance requirements for customs operations.
